configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Server Shortname
configurationFields.description: Sets the shortname of the server shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Server Admin Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server admin shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Make Server Public
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be registered to the master servers and be publicly visible in the in-game browser

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Password for players and spectators to connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: In-game admin password

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of players that may connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Spectator Limit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of spectators that may connect to the server

configurationFields.label: Map Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the map to load. The Game Type must match. If Custom is selected, the Custom Map Name must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Map Name
configurationFields.description: If Custom map is selected, sets the name of the map. The map file must be included in the Maps directory

configurationFields.label: Game Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the game type for the server. If Custom is selected, the Custom Game Type Name must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Game Type Name
configurationFields.description: If Custom game type is selected, sets the name of the game type

configurationFields.label: Mutators
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of mutators to enable on the server

configurationFields.label: Redirection URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for a redirection website for clients to download required files. The URL must end in a slash

configurationFields.label: Enable Webserver
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server's webserver will operate

configurationFields.label: Webserver Admin Username
configurationFields.description: Sets the username of the admin user for the webserver

configurationFields.label: Webserver Admin Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password of the admin user for the webserver. Change this after installing the server

configurationFields.label: Low Gore
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will have low gore levels

configurationFields.label: Very Low Gore
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will have very low gore levels

configurationFields.label: Mute Spectators
configurationFields.description: If enabled, spectators will be muted (cannot chat during the game)

configurationFields.label: Prevent Cheats
configurationFields.description: If enabled, cheats will not be allowed

configurationFields.label: Enable Field of View
configurationFields.description: If set, field of view will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Game Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed of the game

configurationFields.label: Bot Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level of bots on the server

configurationFields.label: Adjust Bot Skill Level
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the skill level of bots will increase or decrease according to the skill level of players

configurationFields.label: Assault: Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Minimum number of players for the Assault standard game type. Vacant slots will be filled with bots. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Assault: Player Wait Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait for players before spawning bots for the Assault standard game type. 0 = start the game immediately

configurationFields.label: Assault: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time limit for the Assault standard game type. 0 = no time limit

configurationFields.label: Capture The Flag: Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Minimum number of players for the Capture the Flag standard game type. Vacant slots will be filled with bots. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Capture The Flag: Player Wait Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait for players before spawning bots for the Capture the Flag standard game type. 0 = start the game immediately

configurationFields.label: Capture The Flag: Score Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the score limit (goal score) for the Capture the Flag standard game type. When reached by a team the game will end

configurationFields.label: Capture The Flag: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time limit for the Capture the Flag standard game type. 0 = no time limit

configurationFields.label: Deathmatch: Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Minimum number of players for the Deathmatch standard game type. Vacant slots will be filled with bots. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Deathmatch: Player Wait Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait for players before spawning bots for the Deathmatch standard game type. 0 = start the game immediately

configurationFields.label: Deathmatch: Frag Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the frag limit (or kill limit) for the Deathmatch standard game type. When reached by a player the game will end

configurationFields.label: Deathmatch: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time limit for the Deathmatch standard game type. 0 = no time limit

configurationFields.label: Domination: Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Minimum number of players for the Domination standard game type. Vacant slots will be filled with bots. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Domination: Player Wait Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait for players before spawning bots for the Domination standard game type. 0 = start the game immediately

configurationFields.label: Domination: Score Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the score limit (goal score) for the Domination standard game type. When reached by a team the game will end

configurationFields.label: Domination: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time limit for the Domination standard game type. 0 = no time limit

configurationFields.label: Team Deathmatch: Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Minimum number of players for the Team Deathmatch standard game type. Vacant slots will be filled with bots. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Team Deathmatch: Player Wait Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait for players before spawning bots for the Team Deathmatch standard game type. 0 = start the game immediately

configurationFields.label: Team Deathmatch: Frag Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the frag limit (or kill limit) for the Team Deathmatch standard game type. When reached by a team the game will end

configurationFields.label: Team Deathmatch: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time limit for the Team Deathmatch standard game type. 0 = no time limit

configurationFields.label: OldUnreal Patch Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the OldUnreal patch version to apply to the server. On Linux, GSCS installs the 64 bit version for 469c and above, unless the 32 bit version is selected. Set the Server Executable for Linux accordingly. Update the server after changing this setting!

configurationFields.label: Server Executable (Linux)
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to run the 32 bit or 64 bit version of the server executable on Linux. The appropriate OldUnreal Patch Version must also be installed

deploymentSteps.name: 7-Zip Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'ut-server/7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe' }; if ($?) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe' }; if ($?) { & ./7zr.exe x -y -aoa 7z-installer.exe *> $null 2>&1; Remove-Item -Path '7z-installer.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

deploymentSteps.name: Base Server Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'ut-server'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://archive.org/download/ut-goty/UT_GOTY_CD1.iso -OutFile 'UT_GOTY_CD1.iso'; if ($?) { & ./7-Zip/7z.exe x -y -aoa UT_GOTY_CD1.iso '-x!Autorun.inf' '-x!Setup.exe' '-x!DirectX7' '-x!DirectX7/*' '-x!GameSpy' '-x!GameSpy/*' '-x!Microsoft' '-x!Microsoft/*' '-x!System400' '-x!System400/*' '-x!System/*.est' '-x!System/*.frt' '-x!System/*.itt' *> $null; Remove-Item 'UT_GOTY_CD1.iso' -Force *> $null }"
